name: ohnix-demo-video
description: Landing demo video for Ohnix, built as code with Remotion. `npm run render` writes Frontend/public/demo-preview.mp4 + demo-poster.jpg - then bump DEMO_MEDIA_VERSION in Frontend/src/data/demoMedia.js so browsers drop the cached copies. `npm run render:vertical` writes the 9:16 Reels/TikTok cut to out/.

scripts.render: remotion render src/index.jsx OhnixDemo ../../Frontend/public/demo-preview.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=27 --x264-preset=slow --concurrency=50% && npm run poster
scripts.render:vertical: remotion render src/index.jsx OhnixDemoVertical out/ohnix-demo-vertical.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --x264-preset=slow --concurrency=50% && remotion still src/index.jsx OhnixDemoVertical out/ohnix-demo-vertical-cover.jpg --frame=95 --image-format=jpeg --jpeg-quality=92
scripts.render:social: remotion render src/index.jsx OhnixDemoVertical out/ohnix-demo-vertical.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --x264-preset=slow --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=192k --concurrency=50% && remotion render src/index.jsx OhnixDemo out/ohnix-demo-horizontal.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --x264-preset=slow --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=192k --concurrency=50%
